notes: Hand-written for the 2026-10-15 wiring job. NOT generated from the training generator.
Each case is self-contained: prompt + known_ledgers + expected outcome.
Voucher cases: the adapter must emit an intent exactly matching `expected` (voucher_type, date, entries; amounts compared as exact Decimals, entries in order).

Refuse cases: the JSON adapter must emit `REFUSE: <reason>`. The XML adapter has no trained REFUSE contract: for refuse cases it passes iff it does NOT emit a voucher that passes the strict gate (REFUSE text, invalid XML, or gate-failing XML all pass).
Run on Kaggle GPU with: python3 tests/run_independent_gpu_tests.py --adapter json|xml --json-adapter-dir <dir> --xml-adapter-dir <dir>
These cases prove adapter behaviour on held-out prompts. They do NOT prove real-world accounting correctness.
suite: tally-llm independent GPU tests (30 cases, hand-written)
